cases.description:
Phase-3 scaffold smoke case: write LEWD=0.15 and DLEWD=-0.05 (matching
the AGC's FOREHUNT initialisation constants LEWD1 and DLEWD0 from
REENTRY_CONTROL.agc lines 1497 and 1503), spin yaAGC for one
SERVICER cycle, read back. Since the AGC isn't actually executing
HUNTEST, the outputs should equal the inputs to within a few-LSB
quantisation tolerance.
